title: Lunchline header
description: A fixed header with a two-line wordmark. On wide screens it starts transparent with light text over a full-window hero, its links strung along a 1px rule with a thick bar over the current section; once the hero has passed, a cream backdrop wipes down behind it, and it tucks away while you scroll down and returns on the way up. On phones it is a cream glass bar with a hairline and a square sand menu button opening a full-height list.
notes: fixed: it overlays the page. With overMedia (default) the first section should be a full-window hero with dark media on wide screens; pass overMedia={false} otherwise
in-page anchors (#story) mark the current section; give those sections matching ids
phones: the page's first section should leave 76px for it
name: lunchline-header
